info.description: One move in a sequence — a name, a sentence, a photograph and a small mark. ⚠ Its position in the run and the delay it animates on are design: the page spaces them and staggers them from how many there are.

photoAlt.description: ⚠ NOT REQUIRED, AT THE CLIENT'S INSTRUCTION — a photograph can now be published with nothing here, and it will be silent to a screen reader and to search. Please still write it, and write what the picture SHOWS. If you replace the picture, replace this too: a description left behind describes the wrong image, which no text check can catch.

icon.description: The small mark beside the step. Decorative — it carries no description because the photograph already says what the step is.
